source: Cursor diet-plan thread 4487c439, Aug 27–28 2026; potatoes added Sep 2

profile.name: Chris
profile.goal: lean bulk — muscle with as little fat as possible

targets.leanBulkNote: Weekly average ~2,750–2,850 (+100–200). Train days surplus, rest days lower carb / higher fat.
targets.scaleRule: Weigh 3–4 mornings/week. Goal +0.25–0.5 lb/week. Flat after 2 weeks → add 100g cooked rice or 150g cooked potato post-lift. Faster than 0.5 lb/week → cut 100g post-lift rice.

rules: Cook with olive oil (½ tbsp on train-day eggs; don't drown the food).
Gym carbs are rice + potatoes. Pre-lift is rice. Post-lift is rice + potato.
Rest days: no rice or potatoes. Carbs from smoothie fruit/honey. Higher fat from beef + guac.
Chicken is the main train-day protein. Beef is the main rest-day protein.
Salt food — 10k steps + lifting burns sodium.
Guac is a fat add-on, not a main carb. Don't eat a whole tub in one day.
Tortillas are fine on rest days if carbs are short. Not on train days — rice and potatoes stay the gym carbs.
Don't slash eggs or milk to chase fat numbers — they carry micros/hormones.

milkBudget.dropped: No milk post-lift (water). No milk at rest dinner (beef + guac instead).

train.label: Train day
train.role: surplus + performance — rice pre-lift, rice + potato post-lift

meals.name: Morning
meals.food: 4 eggs cooked in ½ tbsp olive oil + 2 tbsp guac + 250 ml raw milk

meals.name: Midday
meals.food: 150 g cooked chicken breast + 1 orange + 250 ml raw milk

meals.name: Post-lift
meals.food: 400 g cooked rice + 300 g cooked potato + 50 g cooked ground beef (no guac)

rest.label: Rest day
rest.role: lower carb, hormone fats from beef + eggs + guac

meals.name: Morning smoothie
meals.food: 400 ml raw milk + 1 banana + 1 cup frozen berries (no honey)

meals.name: Lunch
meals.food: 175 g cooked ground beef + 2 eggs + 1 tbsp guac + 200 ml raw milk + 250 g cooked potato (salt the potato)

meals.name: Dinner
meals.food: 175 g cooked ground beef + 2 eggs + 1 tbsp guac + 300 g cooked potato (salted)

prep.rice: 6,500 g cooked for the week → 5× PRE 600 g + 5× POST 700 g
prep.potato: 2,000 g cooked potato for the week → 5× POST 400 g (buy ~5 lb raw)
prep.chicken: 750 g cooked (150 g × 5) from 3 lb raw
prep.beef: 1,300 g cooked total → 50 g × 5 train + 400 g × 2 rest, from 3 lb raw

watch: Calcium is lower with 1 gallon of milk
Magnesium/K a bit lighter with no greens
micros.notes: Rest-day beef carries zinc/iron/B12 for the week. Potatoes add potassium. Salt food. Don't get leaner than ~11–13% while bulking.
